scene.ko: 중요한 화상회의에서 연결이 계속 끊기자 해결을 시도하고, 남은 안건은 다음 날로 다시 잡는다.

lines.en: Sorry about that, Daniel. I got disconnected again. Did you catch the last part about the budget?
lines.ko: 죄송해요, 대니얼 씨. 또 연결이 끊겼어요. 예산에 대한 마지막 부분 들으셨어요?
alt: Sorry, Daniel, I lost my connection again. Did you hear what I said about the budget?

lines.en: Only the beginning. You froze right after you mentioned the second quarter.
lines.ko: 앞부분만요. 2분기 얘기를 꺼내신 직후에 화면이 멈췄어요.

lines.en: I apologize. Our office network has been unstable all day. Let me turn off my camera and see if that helps.
lines.ko: 죄송합니다. 오늘 하루 종일 사무실 네트워크가 불안정하네요. 카메라를 끄고 좀 나아지는지 볼게요.
alt: I'm so sorry. Our internet has been bad all day. I'll turn off my video and see if it helps.

lines.en: Good idea... Hmm, your voice is still cutting in and out.
lines.ko: 좋은 생각이에요... 음, 그래도 목소리가 계속 끊겼다 들렸다 해요.

lines.en: Then how about I call in by phone instead? The dial-in number is in the invitation, right?
lines.ko: 그럼 대신 전화로 접속하면 어떨까요? 전화 접속 번호가 초대장에 있죠?
alt: Okay, then maybe I should join by phone. The number is in the meeting invite, isn't it?

lines.en: Yes, it is. But we only have ten minutes left, and we still need to make a decision on the budget.
lines.ko: 네, 있어요. 그런데 10분밖에 안 남았는데, 아직 예산 결정을 해야 해요.

lines.en: That's true, but I don't think we should rush such an important decision. Would you be open to discussing the budget tomorrow instead?
lines.ko: 맞아요. 하지만 그렇게 중요한 결정을 서둘러 내리면 안 될 것 같아요. 예산 논의는 대신 내일 하는 게 어떠세요?
alt: You're right, but it's too important to rush. Could we move the budget discussion to tomorrow?

lines.en: That's fine with me. I'm free tomorrow at 9 a.m. my time.
lines.ko: 저는 좋아요. 내일 제 쪽 시간으로 오전 9시에 시간이 돼요.

lines.en: That works for me. This time, I'll book a room with a wired connection, and I'll send you my slides in advance, just in case.
lines.ko: 저도 좋아요. 이번에는 유선 인터넷이 되는 회의실을 잡고, 혹시 모르니 슬라이드도 미리 보내 드릴게요.
alt: Great, that works. I'll use a meeting room with wired internet, and I'll email you the slides beforehand, just in case.

lines.en: Sounds like a plan. Let's use the last few minutes to go over the other items.
lines.ko: 좋아요, 그렇게 하죠. 남은 몇 분 동안 다른 안건을 살펴봐요.
